mechanisms.title: Solid Fat Crystal Bridging (Partial Coalescence)
mechanisms.scientific_summary: During whipping, rigid fat crystals pierce the protective milkfat globule membrane (MFGM), causing globules to aggregate into an air-trapping 3D lipid scaffold. When heated above 18°C, crystals melt, causing irreversible lamellar collapse.
mechanisms.thermodynamic_basis: Hydrophobic attractive force and interfacial crystal penetration; irreversible when solid fat content (SFC) approaches zero.

mechanisms.title: Globular Protein Interfacial Adsorption & Denaturation
mechanisms.scientific_summary: Soluble globular whey proteins (beta-lactoglobulin) and egg ovalbumins rapidly diffuse to air-water interfaces, unfurl hydrophobic amino acid residues toward the air phase, and form an elastic steric crosslinked monolayer.
mechanisms.thermodynamic_basis: Gibbs interfacial adsorption equation: dgamma = -sum(Gamma_i * dmu_i). Maximizes entropy by burying hydrophobic residues.

mechanisms.title: Polysaccharide Continuous-Phase Yield Stress (Stokes Arrest)
mechanisms.scientific_summary: Rigid five-fold helical xanthan gum and galactomannan polymers form an entangled physical hydrogel in the continuous aqueous serum, establishing a finite yield stress (tau_y > 0.15 Pa) that completely arrests gravitational drainage.
mechanisms.thermodynamic_basis: Stokes' law drainage velocity v = 2 r^2 (rho_p - rho_f) g / (9 eta); when continuous yield stress exceeds buoyant shear stress, velocity becomes identically zero.

mechanisms.title: Gelatin Sol-Gel Coil-to-Triple-Helix Transition
mechanisms.scientific_summary: Upon cooling below 25°C, random-coil gelatin polypeptide chains form left-handed polyproline II helices that aggregate into right-handed triple-helical junction zones, setting a firm elastic gel that melts cleanly at oral cavity temperature (35°C).
mechanisms.thermodynamic_basis: Enthalpically driven hydrogen-bonding cascade overcoming conformational entropy loss below the denaturation transition temperature.

mechanisms.title: Alginate-Calcium Divalent Ion Chelation (Egg-Box Model)
mechanisms.scientific_summary: Divalent calcium ions (Ca2+) selectively bind to consecutive alpha-L-guluronic acid (G-block) residues on adjacent sodium alginate polysaccharide chains, forming coordination complexes in a dimerized 'egg-box' architecture.
mechanisms.thermodynamic_basis: Ionic coordination entropy gain from water displacement and strong electrostatic attraction between Ca2+ and carboxylate anions.

mechanisms.title: Low-Methoxyl Pectin Calcium Chelation vs High-Methoxyl Sugar Dehydration
mechanisms.scientific_summary: LM pectin crosslinks with calcium ions without requiring sugar, enabling low-calorie preserves, while HM pectin requires 65% sucrose to dehydrate polymer chains and allow hydrophobic methyl ester interactions.
mechanisms.thermodynamic_basis: Thermodynamic water activity reduction (a_w < 0.8) and hydrophobic junction formation vs ionic divalent crosslinking.

mechanisms.title: Gliadin-Glutenin Disulfide Crosslinking & Viscoelastic Network
mechanisms.scientific_summary: Hydrated glutenin macropolymers form intermolecular disulfide bonds providing elastic recoil, while monomeric gliadins confer viscous flow, creating an elastic membrane that retains CO2 gas cells during thermal expansion.
mechanisms.thermodynamic_basis: Thiol-disulfide exchange and hydrogen bonding forming a high-elasticity storage modulus (G' >> G'').

mechanisms.title: Insoluble Particle Interfacial Adsorption (Pickering Stabilization)
mechanisms.scientific_summary: Sub-micron solid particles (insoluble mustard mucilage, starch nanocrystals, or chitin) adsorb irreversibly at the oil-water interface, creating a dense physical steric barrier with extremely high detachment energy.
mechanisms.thermodynamic_basis: Free energy of particle detachment Delta E = pi * r^2 * gamma * (1 - |cos theta|)^2 >> 10^4 k_B T, rendering detachment thermodynamically irreversible.
